newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Cimpor to propose reorganisation plan.
newsitem.headline: Cimpor to propose reorganisation plan.

text.p: The board of Portuguese cement group Cimpor said it would present a five-year plan to reorganise group activities at an extraordinary general meeting today.

"With this (reorganisation) proposal, the board wants to give Cimpor an adequate structure to help the group develop in the medium term, with the objective of doubling the group's production capacity that exists now in Spain and Portugal, that is, around seven million tonnes a year," a statement said.
Under the restructuring a holding company would be created, to be called Cimpor-Cimentos de Portugal.
Cimpor shares closed on the Lisbon bourse yesterday up 11 escudos to 3,278.
